name: Running – I Only Run Downhill
title: Running – I Only Run Downhill Ornament
story: This running ornament is for the runner who is only in it for the downhills: a grinning runner with his arms wide open on a grassy slope, and an easy Christmas stocking gift for a trail runner, a marathon friend or a very tired training partner.

The print is a laughing runner in a red singlet and orange shoes flying down a grassy trail, under I ONLY RUN in navy slab capitals and DOWNHILL. in red, on a warm cream disc. The art matches our I Only Run Downhill tee, so the ornament makes a set with the shirt.

Every runner knows the feeling: the climb is the price, and the downhill is the reward. The ornament says it in four words and one very happy runner. Hang it on a sturdy branch, tuck it into a stocking, or tie it to a gift for the person who signs up for every race and walks every hill. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.
joke_a: Running uphill hurts and running downhill is free, so some runners only count the second kind. The I Only Run Downhill ornament from Graphic Tees Co. prints a laughing runner with his arms wide on a grassy slope, so any runner gets the joke on the tree at a glance.
